SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW testData AS SELECT * FROM VALUES
SESSION	SET spark.sql.ansi.enabled = false
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW view_ansi AS SELECT ColumnA + 1 FROM testData
SESSION	SET spark.sql.ansi.enabled = true
READ	SELECT * FROM view_ansi
SESSION	SET spark.sql.caseSensitive = false
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW view_case_sensitivity AS SELECT CoLuMNa FROM testData
SESSION	SET spark.sql.caseSensitive = true
READ	SELECT * FROM view_case_sensitivity
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS view_ansi
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS view_case_sensitivity
